name: Alexandria Philosophy MCP
description: Semantic search over 4.6 million text chunks from 20,000+ classical philosophy and humanities works — Plato, Aristotle, Kant, Nietzsche, Hegel, Hume and thousands more — sourced from Archive.org. Supports author, language and topic filtering with hybrid dense+sparse retrieval and cross-encoder reranking.

examples.title: Search Nietzsche
examples.description: Find passages on the will to power and eternal recurrence
examples.command: search_texts query="Nietzsche will to power eternal recurrence" author="Nietzsche"

examples.title: Kantian ethics
examples.description: Find passages on the categorical imperative
examples.command: search_texts query="categorical imperative duty ethics" author="Kant"

examples.description: List books by Plato in the collection
